<function name="SortFiles" parent="DFileBrowser" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Sorts the file list.

<note>This is only functional when not using the model viewer. See <page>DFileBrowser:SetModels</page></note>
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="descending" type="boolean" default="false">The sort order. `true` for descending (z-a), `false` for ascending (a-z).</arg>
	</args>
</function>
